topics.name: Graphics, navigation and radar
topics.validation_focus: Check exact target, prerequisites and mod combinations; report exercised visual/runtime scenarios and measurements.

method_families.name: Model conversion and inspection
method_families.method: Inspect source geometry, materials and skeleton; map coordinates and bone influences to the target format; export and reimport before testing the model in-game.
method_families.inputs: Permitted model/texture fixtures, source and target format versions, skeleton metadata and authoring dependency revisions.
method_families.checks: Bone identity, normalized weights and influence limits, UV/material assignments, scale/orientation, format roundtrip and exercised poses.
method_families.limits: Conversion scripts include asset-specific assumptions. Blender, DragonFF and Sollumz are external dependencies, not Valkyrie tools.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; continuous torso fitting regression executed in Blender 4.5.8. Paired DFF/IFP locomotion sampling executed with locally supplied inputs; gameplay acceptance remains pending. Other host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: World indexing and map preparation
method_families.method: Index archives and loose overrides using a declared precedence rule; resolve placed models/textures; compute bounds and prepare map outputs from separately supplied inputs.
method_families.inputs: Permitted archive/placement fixtures, game profile, coordinate conventions and override rules.
method_families.checks: Missing references, override precedence, transformed bounds, coordinate mapping, output coverage and deterministic fixture results.
method_families.limits: Historical extractors contain expanded-map assumptions. Stock-game compatibility and complete texture coverage must be established per target.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Road graphs and navigation audits
method_families.method: Inspect graph headers, nodes and edges; check coordinates and connectivity; prepare the expected navigation payload and compare routes with observed surfaces.
method_families.inputs: Permitted graph fixtures, target graph schema, coordinate range and consumer expectations.
method_families.checks: Header/version, node/link validity, connected components, bounds, payload integrity and separately exercised navigation behavior.
method_families.limits: Existing payload joiners are consumer-specific. A structurally valid graph does not prove route quality or runtime compatibility.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Texture dictionary inspection and preparation
method_families.method: Inventory texture names and native formats; inspect decode failures; convert or merge permitted inputs while preserving the target dictionary contract.
method_families.inputs: Original/synthetic texture fixtures, RenderWare/native format versions and decoder/converter revisions.
method_families.checks: Name resolution, dimensions, alpha, mip chains, compression, roundtrip readability and unresolved material references.
method_families.limits: Decoder coverage differs by texture format. Conversion success alone does not establish correct lighting, alpha or mip behavior in-game.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Collision inspection and comparison
method_families.method: Identify the exact collision/container format; inspect primitives and model coverage; compare visual and collision geometry with controlled queries.
method_families.inputs: Permitted collision fixtures, model identifiers, transform conventions and exact container version.
method_families.checks: Primitive counts, bounds, model-key coverage, transformed ray hits and behavior before any geometry cleanup.
method_families.limits: CADB helpers are format-specific, including a v2 comparison. Collision cleanup can change gameplay and needs separate consumer validation.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Animation inspection and retargeting
method_families.method: Inspect animation blocks and track identities; map skeleton/coordinate conventions; retarget selected tracks while preserving names, ordering and untouched data.
method_families.inputs: Permitted animation fixtures, exact IFP variant, source/target skeletons and reference pose.
method_families.checks: Track identity, frame times, root motion, quaternion/transform conventions, untouched chunks and affected playback scenarios.
method_families.limits: Some inspectors have historical local-path defaults; retargeting is target-specific. A readable animation is not proof of correct game playback.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Binary, hook and protocol analysis
method_families.method: Identify the exact target; inventory candidate hooks/interfaces; compare bounded signatures and analysis evidence across matching revisions; label inferred semantics explicitly.
method_families.inputs: Independently obtained permitted binaries, SHA-256/size, architecture, load base and analysis-tool revision.
method_families.checks: VA versus RVA, signature uniqueness, instruction context, interface/version matches and observations versus reconstruction hypotheses.
method_families.limits: Existing analyzers target specific binaries. Decompilation and signature matches do not establish semantic equivalence or a complete rebuild.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Build provenance and release verification
method_families.method: Declare reviewed input paths and revisions; detect drift before copying; verify artifact identity, explicit file scope and checksums; record each executed validation gate.
method_families.inputs: Project-owned source, reviewed manifests, dependency pins and expected artifact contract.
method_families.checks: Source revision/dirty state, path scope, expected previous hashes, artifact architecture/resources, archive integrity and separately recorded tests.
method_families.limits: Existing sync and artifact checkers are project-specific. These notes are principles, not a supplied universal build system. CLEO AI remains an external tool.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Generated application content
method_families.method: Separate procedurally generated art/audio from imported material. Generate original fixtures, declare layout/audio parameters, and prepare a content pack with a manifest of inputs and outputs.
method_families.inputs: Original drawings and synthesis parameters or independently permitted source content, font/dependency revisions, output dimensions, sample rate and pack schema.
method_families.checks: Determinism, image dimensions/alpha, waveform duration/sample rate/clipping, page layout/link regions, pack readability and per-input provenance.
method_families.limits: Existing generators mix procedural work with project assets or separately obtained game/web content. Documentation does not authorize redistribution of those inputs or resulting packs. The general method can be reproduced with original fixtures.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.

method_families.name: Terrain-aware signal-coverage experiments
method_families.method: Rasterize permitted terrain geometry to a height grid, declare transmitter positions/heights and sampling rules, then estimate a coverage grid under explicitly recorded propagation and obstacle assumptions.
method_families.inputs: Original/synthetic terrain and mast fixtures, grid bounds/resolution, units, missing-data handling, antenna/receiver heights, frequency and model parameters.
method_families.checks: Coordinate alignment, empty/missing tiles, interpolation and sampling, repeatability, sensitivity to heights/obstacles, and declared mapping from estimated loss to display bands.
method_families.limits: The existing study has historical map extents, terrain fallbacks and fixed display thresholds. It is an experimental approximation, not measured radio coverage or proof of integration into a game feature. Synthetic reproduction is a proposed next experiment, not a completed test.
method_families.evaluation: Python source syntax and inventory checked; collision/content/signal synthetic demos executed. Host/game/project-dependent tools are not claimed runtime-tested.
